text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- An average of 9,000 Mozambican women die every year from pregnancy-related causes, one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the world, according to Dr Zulma Lattes of the United Nations Population Fund.

- Mozambique's cotton production could double this year to 55,000 tonnes, said a report presented to a national meeting of cotton companies in Maputo on Wednesday. Cotton is Mozambique's second-largest export product after prawns.
